نشتاق (form VIII)
# نَشْتَاقُ (naštāqu) /naʃ.taː.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَاقَ (ištāqa)
# نَشْتَاقَ (naštāqa) /naʃ.taː.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَاقَ (ištāqa)
